color_definitions.purple: Top-tier / raving fan. Highest value or most engaged; protect and look for referrals or expansion.
color_definitions.green: Healthy. On track, no open issues in the data.
color_definitions.yellow: Needs attention. Something open or slipping; act this week before it turns red.
color_definitions.red: At risk. Open issue, complaint, or no response in the data; act today.
